name: herdr
description: The runtime coding agents live on: a terminal workspace for running agents side by side. Installed from the release manifest, which the installer checks against its sha256.
install: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://herdr.dev/install.sh -o "$t" && HERDR_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin sh "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
upgrade: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://herdr.dev/install.sh -o "$t" && HERDR_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin sh "$t"; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
